# Skill: personalization-engine

Use when an agent needs to design or audit personalization and
recommendation systems.

## Rules
- Always base personalization on first-party, consented data only.
- Define user segments from behavioral signals, not assumptions.
- Design recommendation logic: collaborative filtering, content-based,
  hybrid approaches.
- Evaluate recommendation diversity and serendipity to avoid filter
  bubbles.
- Propose A/B test design for personalization variants with clear
  success metrics.
- Never recommends personalization that could create filter bubbles,
  bias, or privacy violations.
